source_note: Named rule catalogue (Session 4). One entry per thing the deterministic engine actually checks: each incompatible hazard pair in hazard_rules_v1.json, the overhead-work check, the fire-watch capacity limit, and one per certificate kind. Contacts are ROLES, never named people. Citation 'verified' follows navsea_8010_psns_v2014.json's convention: true only for an entry read against the primary source (the three NAVSEA entries were, on 2026-08-08, ADR-023). Every 29 CFR section below was added in Session 4 from general knowledge of Part 1915's structure and is verified=false until someone reads the eCFR text for it and flips it. These citations explain a rule; they never decide one -- detection stays in deconfliction.py and certificates.py.

rules.title: Hot work in or adjacent to a confined or enclosed space
rules.note: 29 CFR 1915.14 covers hot work in confined/enclosed spaces (Subpart B). NAVSEA8010-4.4.4 (multiple levels) is cited because hot material can travel between the spaces involved.

rules.title: Hot work in the same envelope as work aloft
rules.note: Falling slag or sparks reaching staging or workers aloft; NAVSEA8010-4.4.4 requires a fire watch at each level unless positive means prevent spread or fall of hot material.

rules.title: Work aloft concurrent with fall-protection work in the same envelope
rules.note: Known Debt (ARCHITECTURE.md): working aloft requires fall protection, so this pair can flag a compliant configuration. Kept as a review prompt, not a violation finding.

rules.title: Overhead work above other work with no vertical deconfliction confirmed
rules.note: No specific 29 CFR section mapped yet for overhead work above other crews; left uncited rather than guessed. Fires when one package is aloft or over the side and the other shares its frame range.

rules.title: Fire watch covering more than four concurrent hot workers
rules.note: Limit of four from NAVSEA8010-4.4.3, verified against the primary source (ADR-023).

rules.title: Hot work permit must cover the whole work window
Confined space entry permit must cover the whole work window
Fall protection plan must cover the whole work window
Marine chemist certificate must cover the whole work window
Competent person inspection must cover the whole work window
